source_and_access: The official [community-board directory](https://www.nyc.gov/site/communityboards/about/manhattan-boards.page) supplies board sites; boards publish heterogeneous HTML/PDF minutes and sometimes vote sheets, for example [Manhattan CB3](https://www.nyc.gov/site/manhattancb3/minutes/meeting-vote-records.page) and [Queens CB8](https://www.nyc.gov/site/queenscb8/meetings/board-meeting-minutes.page). Borough-president recommendation pages are additional board-specific sources, not a citywide feed.
join_feasibility: **Measured:** fixed borough-stratified sample joined **0/10 (0%)** by exact body + meeting date + publisher ULURP after expanding collectable minutes indexes from 8 to 17 ([receipt](../site/data/non_council_outcome_sources/verification_receipts/non_council_minutes_votes_2026-08-11.json); prior 0/10 at 8 pages: [2026-08-04](../site/data/non_council_outcome_sources/verification_receipts/non_council_minutes_votes_2026-08-04.json)). Fixture precision on publisher-ULURP keys is 100% but usefulness stays below 30%.
reader_value: **5** — Meetings and Land; attendees and neighborhood advocates learn what happened, how a board voted, and where minutes live.
disposition: **Infrastructure landed; edge stopped.** Registry + collector + empty lookup ship; no notice-level outcome edge until usefulness ≥30% and precision 100%.
